R1_parser_admitted.evidence: Crash-stack frame 7 is exactly lstmrecognizer.cpp:308. The image was admitted through GetUTF8Text -> recog_all_words -> classify_word_pass1 -> LSTMRecognizeWord into the LSTM network forward pass.

R2_source_reached.evidence: Harness frame LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput at fuzzer-api.cpp:94 present (crash frame 17); the crash inside GetUTF8Text proves the createPix-produced Pix was OCR'd. Exact line-80 coverage deferred to a --coverage rebuild.

R3_vulnerable_function_reached.evidence: Crash-stack frame 5: FullyConnected::Forward at fullyconnected.cpp:153 (the ForwardTimeStep call site within the same function that holds the root-cause Init at line 138).

R4_vulnerable_line_reached.evidence: The root-cause Init at line 138 executes and returns before the crash, so it does not appear as a live crash frame; its execution is confirmed by (a) the enclosing FullyConnected::Forward being on the stack (frame 5) and (b) the patch differential: modifying exactly this line to Init(ro, scratch) makes the identical PoC exit 0 on the fix image. line-level llvm-cov of the returned frame is deferred.

R5_sink_reached.evidence: Exactly crash-stack frame 0. ASan container-overflow WRITE of size 32 at 0x62100000b87f, SUMMARY intsimdmatrixavx2.cpp:136:3 in tesseract::ExtractResults16.

patch_differential.vul_result: AddressSanitizer container-overflow WRITE size 32 at intsimdmatrixavx2.cpp:136, ABORTING (exit 1)
patch_differential.fix_result: Executed /tmp/poc in 131 ms, exit 0 (no sanitizer error)
patch_differential.changed_lines: src/lstm/fullyconnected.cpp:138  temp_lines[i].Init(no_, ro, scratch)  ->  temp_lines[i].Init(ro, scratch)
patch_differential.evidence: The ONLY code change between images is the FullyConnected output-buffer sizing; vul-crash AND fix-clean over the identical PoC prove line 138 is the root cause.

deferred.reason: Line coverage of nodes not present as live crash frames (e.g. source line 80, root-cause line 138 which has returned) needs a -fprofile-instr-generate -fcoverage-mapping rebuild; slow under qemu. Run on a native amd64 host. All such nodes are already reachability-witnessed via adjacent crash/alloc frames or patch differential.

Byte-level dataflow from the fuzzer testcase to the store at intsimdmatrixavx2.cpp:136 needs a -fsanitize=dataflow build + harness labeling; heavy under qemu. Note the overflow COUNT is fixed by network geometry (Roundup(no_,8) vs no_), not by the tainted value magnitude.

cross_validation.note: Sink (intsimdmatrixavx2.cpp:136) == crash frame 0. Root cause (fullyconnected.cpp:138) == the sole patched line, confirmed by patch differential. All GT-asserted source lines (fullyconnected.cpp:136/138, intsimdmatrixavx2.cpp:136, networkscratch.h:147/148) were read from the vulnerable image and match verbatim. The ASan allocation stack points at LSTM::Forward:289 -> FloatVec::Init:147 (the pooled backing store's reserve) rather than the FullyConnected Init; this is expected NetworkScratch buffer reuse and is already documented in the GT (allocation_stack + cross_validation note) — not a defect. No refuted nodes/edges; no GT revision required.
